tool_args.rationale: The measured response increases sublinearly with current input and decreases with gradient. A numerically fitted saturating flux with a smooth gradient modulation captures both effects; fresh confirmation must determine whether it meets the 0.045 RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot saturates and the additional observations show substantial gradient dependence.
All observations share the same horizon and initial context, so its dynamics are not separately identifiable; a compact gradient-modulated saturation model is testable at the target horizon.
Both informative listed probes have already been acquired; use fresh confirmation to test the fitted stationary model.
